description: This file defines the 'LoanRepaymentScheduleHistory' entity class, which models historical records of loan repayment schedules, including details such as installment number, due date, principal, interest, fees, penalties, and audit information. It is part of the domain layer for loan schedule management within a mortgage or loan management system.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing a historical record of a loan repayment schedule, including details of installment, dates, amounts, related loan and rescheduling request, and audit fields.
